visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Else-If Ladder Instead of Range Checks
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Each grade is a separate if with a lower and an upper bound, and the result is stored in a variable. Use an else-if ladder with early returns, where the upper bounds are implied. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Because the ladder stops at the first match, each branch only needs its lower bound; the upper bound is already covered by the branches above. There is no way to leave a gap or overlap between ranges.
